instruction: I want to preserve battery life on my laptop. Can you enable the power saver mode for me?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling power saver mode on low battery via gsettings. The setup disables power-saver-profile-on-low-battery, and the task asks the user to enable it. Evaluator verifies the setting is changed to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking gsettings power saver pattern - the setting is a boolean that should be toggled from false to true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the power-saver-profile-on-low-battery setting value using gsettings command
Metric (exact_match) appropriately performs exact string comparison for boolean-like gsettings output
Expected value 'true\n' correctly includes the newline character that gsettings outputs
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement (enabling power saver mode)
Data flow is correct: setup sets to false, task requires enabling (setting to true), evaluator verifies it's true
No edge case issues - gsettings command is deterministic and reliable for this setting
